name: Moon
hook: Apollo, the tides and the Moon itself: a small set of facts covers decades of lunar clues.

facts.label: Apollo 11
facts.statement: Apollo 11 landed the first people on the Moon in July 1969: Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin walked while Michael Collins orbited in Columbia, and their lunar module was the Eagle.

facts.label: Alan Shepard
facts.statement: Alan Shepard was the oldest man to walk on the Moon and the only World War II veteran to do so; he also hit a golf ball there.

facts.label: Buzz Aldrin
facts.statement: Buzz Aldrin was the second man on the Moon; after the 1969 walk he wrote Return to Earth.

facts.label: the tides
facts.statement: The Moon and Sun drive Earth's tides; Galileo wrongly blamed them on Earth's orbit rather than the Moon's pull.

facts.label: Apollo 13
facts.statement: Apollo 13 had to swing back to Earth without landing after an oxygen tank ruptured.

facts.label: Saturn V
facts.statement: The Saturn V rocket, based on a concept by Wernher von Braun, sent the Apollo missions to the Moon.

facts.label: Galileo's experiment
facts.statement: In 1971 an astronaut on the Moon repeated Galileo's falling-body experiment and declared that Galileo had been correct.
